notes: Network Terminal: every item shows how many the whole network holds right on its slot, like a crate's front (8.1k); point at it for the exact number. Taking one still gives a stack. Also in 4.53.0: items you put in a networked Deepcore Chest now move by themselves into a networked crate that already holds (or is locked to) the same item, while that crate has room. Also in 4.52.0: the Network Cable has a new look (black cable with green lights).
